summary: Iteration 52 — Verified SWR refactor + shared ListSkeleton. CRITICAL BUG found in /app/frontend/src/lib/swr.js (useApiSWR passed `undefined` as fetcher, which SWR v2 resolve-args treats as 'no fetcher' when 3 args are given, so ZERO network requests were fired for /tenants, /apartments, /contracts SWR keys — UI silently rendered empty state). Fixed by passing fetcher from merged config explicitly as 2nd arg. After the fix: (a) 1st tab visit shows skeleton then loads data (5 tenants), (b) 2nd tab visit is INSTANT with no skeleton (SWR cache hit), (c) create/delete tenant triggers mutate() and list updates without full reload, (d) 9/9 backend regression tests pass (login 200/401, list endpoints 200, contract/payment PDFs 200, google callback 401 not 500).

critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL fix applied: `useSWR(key, undefined, config)` in v2.5+ resolve-args returns args[1] (undefined) as fetcher when args.length>2, disabling all fetches. Correct pattern is either `useSWR(key, fetcher, config)` (fetcher explicit) or `useSWR(key, config)` (2 args, config.fetcher used). Wrapper now passes `merged.fetcher` explicitly.

swr.js has no SWRConfig provider at app root — every hook uses local defaults. Consider wrapping <App> in <SWRConfig value={defaultConfig}> so 3rd-party useSWR calls (if any added later) also inherit fetcher/dedupe/revalidate settings.
ListSkeleton refactor is clean (single shared component, testid prop). No issues.

context_for_next_testing_agent: SWR wrapper fix is in /app/frontend/src/lib/swr.js. Before this fix, ALL useApiSWR hooks were no-ops (no network, no data). Verified network trace: after fix, `/api/tenants` fires on 1st visit only; 2nd tab visit uses cache (0 requests, instant render). Selectors: [data-testid='tenants-skeleton'|'apts-skeleton'|'contracts-skeleton'], [data-testid='tenant-new-btn'|'tenant-save'|'tenant-modal'|'tenant-row-{id}']. To reproduce SWR instant-cache verification: login → open Huurders (skeleton flashes, then rows) → open Appartementen → open Huurders again → no skeleton, immediate 5 rows.
rca of the issue: SWR v2 resolve-args logic: `args.length > 2 ? args[1] : ... : config.fetcher`. Passing `useSWR(key, undefined, config)` sends 3 args, so args[1]=undefined is used as fetcher → SWR never calls fetcher → data stays undefined → UI shows empty state instead of loading + real data. Mitigation: pass fetcher explicitly, or use only 2 args (key, config). Applied the explicit-fetcher fix; verified all 3 tabs (Huurders/Appartementen/Contracten) now fetch, cache, mutate correctly.
